maintenance_led.reason: Sells new audio, haptics and mixed-signal ICs designed into customers' new smartphones, laptops and other products; not repair or aftermarket.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are consumer electronics makers (smartphones, PCs, automotive), paid by private businesses and consumers, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through its own chip design and product launches; only occasional acquisitions, no roll-up pattern.

mission_critical.reason: Audio codecs, smart amplifiers and haptics ICs are designed into customers' products; switching requires redesign, re-qualification and software changes.
